**Schedule suggestion:**
| Date  | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Oct 26, Sat  | Seoul > SF |

| Nov 2-3, Sat-Sun  | SF > Sonoma car, wineries (w/Michael?) |

**Task List:**
- [x] 1. Book flights Alex: SL>SF>CHI
- [x] 2. Book flights Ana: SL>SF>SL
- [x] 3. Book hotel SF, Oct 26 - Nov 2
- [x] 4. Book hotel Sonoma, Nov 2 - Nov 3
- [x] 5. [Buy GitHub Universe ticket x1](https://reg.githubuniverse.com/flow/github/universe24/Registration/login)
- [x] 6. [Register for AI x web3 Summit](https://www.aw3.ai/event/add12af4-e9ae-45a9-a1a8-b9c4232a00f2/regProcessStep1)
[**VENUE MAP GOOGLE**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zasUp9DE7y93BbX16)
------------------------------
**[GitHub Universe](https://githubuniverse.com)**, Oct 29, Tue - Oct 30, Wed
No networking event links, need to buy official tickets to network.
- **Tickets** ($1,299 only optimal option): https://githubuniverse.com/#tickets
- **Schedule:** [link](https://reg.githubuniverse.com/flow/github/universe24/attendee-portal/page/sessioncatalog?tab.day=20241029)
-------------------------------
**[Palo Alto AI x Web3 Summit](https://www.aw3.ai/event/add12af4-e9ae-45a9-a1a8-b9c4232a00f2/summary)**, Oct 30-31
Looks small and niche, maybe targeted to students as the venue is in Stanford campus.
Idk the hosts, their websites are a bit sus. But maybe it's just me.
A few potentially interesting speakers.
- **Hosts:**
CTH Group (global blockchain ecosystem builder) - https://www.cth.group
MetaEra (Web3 news, HongKong) - https://www.metaera.hk
- **Tickets:** [link](https://www.aw3.ai/event/add12af4-e9ae-45a9-a1a8-b9c4232a00f2/regProcessStep1)
Free, need to get approved by the host.
I applied as a trial, will let u know if I get approved or not

A few other potentially interesting side events in SF during the trip.
**Side events for [TechCrunch Disrupt 2024](https://techcrunch.com/events/tc-disrupt-2024/)**, Oct 28-30
_Huge conference for founders and VSc in tech, not web3-related but has AI and Fintech topics. [Tickets](https://techcrunch.com/events/tc-disrupt-2024/tickets/) start from $225
Seems like side events don't require a ticket to the main event._
- Oct 29, Tue 6pm: [**TechCrunch Disrupt 2024 Official Afterparty - For Founders & Investors**](https://lu.ma/l0ac2eyx)
- Oct 30, Wed 6pm: [**Founder Friends in SF #Disrupt2024**](https://lu.ma/FFSFDisruptWeek)
**Other**
- Oct 30, Wed 10am: [**AI Hackathon with NVIDIA**](https://lu.ma/nhnos3l3) - may be able to find some AI coders here?
_None or NA for November events list yet_
